units: <cite ref="Chagigah 26b">Ḥag. 26ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 96b">Men. 96ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>כלי עץ העשוי לנ׳</he> a wooden utensil intended for resting things on it (table &c.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 25:2">Gen. R. s. 25</cite>; s. 33 <he>לשם נ׳ התיבה נקרא</he> Noah was named from the resting of the ark (<cite ref="Genesis 8:4">Gen. VIII, 4</cite>).
<cite ref="Yevamot 103b:19">Yeb. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>סנדל של נ׳ ע״ז</he> Ar. (in ed. our w. omitted) a sandal used as a rest for an idol.
<cite ref="Eruvin 83b:11">Erub. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>שלזה תשמישו בנ׳</he> which one neighbor can make use of with ease, opp. <cite ref="B01149"><he>בקשה</he></cite> with difficulty.
<cite ref="Berakhot 56b:18">Ber. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>בנ׳</he> at a slow trot, opp. <he>ברדוף</he> at full speed.
Snh. 92ᵃ, v. נָהַג; a. fr.—נ׳ רוח gratification, pleasure.
<cite ref="Ketubot 95a:8">Keth. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>תימא נ׳ ר׳ עשיתי לבעלי</he> she may say, I did it only to gratify my husband (but did not mean to sell).
<cite ref="Chagigah 16b:18">Ḥag. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי לעשות נ׳ ר׳ לנשים</he> to let the (offering) women have the satisfaction (of putting their hands on the sacrifices).
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:6">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>ועושה נ׳ ר׳ ליוצרו</he> and acts so as to please his Creator; a. fr.
